current_supplemental_decisions.rationale: Accept revised full instruction, not the older dat wording. Fronted g tizwiri supplies temporal at-the-start scope for the following command; in the empty-images guard this naturally orders adding images before normalization or batch cropping. Unlike a bare relational before, beginning is a complete nominal complement, so no omitted comparison is needed. The imperative rnu governs free-state plural tiwlafin. The official chronological paragraph confirms temporal beginning semantics, while standalone instructional use and scope are my independent composition judgment. No ordinal-first-image reading is introduced.

Accept full contextual command. Rnu is positive add, i supplies destination, and feminine tnkul t (one word in the actual value) is the annexed form after the preposition. The understood direct object is the current colour: saveCustom actually calls paletteStore.add(value.colour), not creation of a new palette. I assess tankult n iklan here as a transparent colour-box/colour-collection metaphor, not an independently proven standardized dictionary translation of palette. IRCAM indexed tankult means box and its paint-box compound corroborates the container metaphor; app presence alone is not the reason for acceptance. The genitive colour complement and destination relation preserve the useful collection meaning.

Accept full command with source relation sg, not deletion of the palette. Kks permits removing an understood selected object; the swatch-specific dialog title identifies it, and action2 removes only store[index]. Annexed feminine tnkult after sg is appropriate; genitive n iklan remains inside the colour-box noun phrase. Primary watch/unwatch instructions independently establish add-to versus remove-from relations. Colour-box is an original bounded metaphor for stored swatches, not a claim that a physical paint box or an entire collection is destroyed.

Accept complete positive edit directive. Snfl governs free-state direct object tankult, contrasting with the annexed forms after i/sg in the other commands. N iklan modifies the container noun, so the whole object is the colour collection. Primary edit-page/edit-description commands corroborate this transitive use. This key has no literal production consumer; acceptance is catalogue wording only, not verification of a live edit-palette action. Colour-box metaphor is independently assessed as meaningful here, not taken as a canonical dictionary palette equivalence.
